identity.name: Tank Must de Cartier

case.bezel: flat sapphire crystal, rectangular case, no bezel

identity.one_liner: The entry-level Tank, reintroduced in 2021 with a quartz movement and an interchangeable steel bracelet aimed at buyers priced out of the gold Tank Louis Cartier.

narrative.story: The Tank Must name first appeared in the 1970s as Cartier's quartz-powered, accessibly priced Tank for a market squeezed by the quartz crisis. Cartier revived the name in April 2021 with a new large-and-small steel line built around a swappable bracelet, putting a Tank silhouette within reach of buyers who could not stretch to the gold Tank Louis Cartier. The current large steel model, WSTA0106, is the direct descendant of that relaunch generation.
narrative.collector_notes: Cartier has revised the Tank Must reference numbers more than once since the 2021 relaunch as dial colors and strap options rotated; buyers should confirm which generation a given WSTA code belongs to before assuming interchangeability of parts.
